conventions.convention: Connections are smooth connections on a principal right SU(N)-bundle over S³ or S⁴, with N ≥ 2; the affine connection space carries its C∞ section topology. Holonomy is expressed in a fixed based frame.
Irreducibility means absence of a common nonzero proper invariant complex subspace of the standard holonomy representation on C^N; it does not mean that holonomy equals SU(N).
The complex Grassmannian is represented by Hermitian idempotent matrices of trace k with the inherited real matrix topology. Dimensions and codimensions are real.

Relative avoidance fixes the original family on an open neighborhood of the subpolyhedron throughout the homotopy. Smallness is required only for each prescribed finite list of section seminorms and positive tolerances.
The holonomy-witness, avoidance, weak-contractibility and disk-filling statements assume ZF with full Choice, which supplies the Countable Choice required by the transversality and Sard suppliers.
For j ≥ 1, π_j is defined using continuous maps from I^j sending its entire boundary to the basepoint, modulo homotopies fixed on that boundary.

load_bearing.statement: Under ZF with Choice, for the stated smooth SU(N)-bundle over S³ or S⁴, every continuous finite-polyhedron family of smooth connections that is irreducible on a subpolyhedron admits a continuous homotopy into the irreducible locus, fixed on an open neighborhood of that subpolyhedron throughout, and arbitrarily small in any prescribed finite list of C∞ section seminorms.

Under the stated sphere, bundle, frame and Choice hypotheses, every smooth irreducible connection has a finite tuple of based piecewise-smooth loops whose holonomies have no common nonzero proper invariant complex subspace; the same tuple witnesses irreducibility on a C¹ neighborhood. Consequently the irreducible locus is C∞-open.

For N ≥ 2, r ≥ 1 and 1 ≤ k < N, the incidence set I_{k,r} of r special-unitary matrices preserving a k-plane is a closed embedded smooth submanifold of SU(N)^r × Gr_C(k,N), of dimension 2k(N−k)+r(k²+(N−k)²−1), ambient codimension 2rk(N−k), and dimension deficit dim SU(N)^r−dim I_{k,r}=2(r−1)k(N−k).
For N ≥ 2 and 1 ≤ k < N, Hermitian idempotents of trace k identify with complex k-planes in C^N; the finite union over these k of their projection-model Grassmannians is compact.

Assume ZF with Choice. For any smooth principal right SU(N)-bundle over S³ or S⁴, N ≥ 2, with the stated reference connection and based frame, the smooth irreducible connection locus with its C∞ section topology is nonempty and path-connected, and π_j at every irreducible basepoint vanishes for every integer j ≥ 1.

published_dependencies.used_for: Claim 2 supplies choice-free compactness of closed bounded subsets of positive-dimensional Euclidean matrix space.
Regular-level constructions of unitary groups and block stabilizers, and local incidence-preimage dimension calculations.
Claim 2 gives a strictly positive minimum of the continuous finite-holonomy obstruction function on the nonempty compact union of Grassmannians.
Existence and uniqueness of parallel transport on compact loop segments after realifying the complex matrix equation.
Smooth dependence of segment transport and finite holonomy tuples on ambient smoothing parameters and connection perturbation parameters.
Under Countable Choice, exceptional perturbation parameters for transversality to each holonomy-incidence manifold form a null set.
The incidence-preimage projection has source dimension smaller than the perturbation-parameter dimension, so its image is null.
Choosing arbitrarily small good perturbations in the positive-dimensional parameter ball.
Combining the finitely many exceptional sets indexed by proper subspace dimension.
The explicit foundational assumption in the holonomy, avoidance, weak-contractibility and example statements.
Identifying the weaker choice assumption required by the finite-dimensional null-set and transversality suppliers.
The based-cube convention and interpretation of a based nullhomotopy as the zero homotopy class.

seams_checked.note: Opened the configuration definition and checked its smooth affine connection space, C∞ topology, right-bundle convention and standard-representation holonomy irreducibility against the assigned consumers. The consumers restrict its dimension-3/4 base hypothesis to S³/S⁴ and retain Choice. They do not require full SU(N) holonomy or infer smooth weak contractibility from a Sobolev statement.

The example specializes the configuration definition to the trivial bundle and product connection. Its identity-holonomy computation, reducibility for N ≥ 2, and continuous affine cone use the stated smooth topology; the irreducible filling is separately supplied by relative avoidance.

Opened thm-qftx-singer-global-gauge-section-obstruction. Its F4 and proof steps 2.1–3.1 use precisely nonemptiness, path connectedness and vanishing positive based homotopy groups for smooth irreducible connections on every stated sphere-bundle sector. They do not strengthen weak contractibility to contractibility. The displayed orbit-projection square has compatible objects, arrows and compositions.
